name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description: With your arms by your sides, curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders by bending your elbows, then lower slowly.
setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, a light dumbbell in each hand (filled water bottles work too), palms facing forward.
cues: Keep your elbows by your sides.
Don't swing your body to lift.
Lower slowly. You can also do this sitting down.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Curl
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows to bring the weights to your shoulders.
